newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: African Mining seeks new JCI stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: African Mining seeks new JCI stake - paper.

text.p: African Mining Group, the consortium that bid for 34.9 percent of JCI Ltd, is negotiating with Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd to buy a further 13 percent of the group at a discount to reduce the average share price, Business Day newspaper said on Tuesday.
The paper quoted Anglo spokesman Michael Spicer confirming that the parties were engaged in discussions, although he declined to comment in detail.

Last November AMG -- led by Capital Alliance Holdings Ltd -- agreed to buy 52.8 million JCI shares at 54.50 rand a share. Since then the shares fell back, although they recovered late last week and closed on Monday at 49.00, the same price when the deal was struck in November.
